PLAY · GROWING SPIRALS

Snail Spiral Drawing

Start in the middle of the shell and spin around and around, getting bigger each time.

One perfect shell!

Spiral control is a giant step for little pencils. The snail is proud.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game builds growing spirals — one of the foundation strokes behind handwriting. Tracing a clear path with a finger or a stylus teaches speed, rhythm and control long before pencils arrive on paper, and the generous engine means an honest attempt is always celebrated. Watch for the moment the whole arm starts doing the work instead of the wrist — that is the real milestone.

The worksheet button prints the original artwork with its tracing guides, a title and the instruction — perfect for a kitchen-table session. The my-drawing button saves exactly what your child drew on screen. Short, happy sessions of two or three adventures beat one long push, every time.
